# Moisés Cedeño

> Tech Lead and solutions architect focused on healthcare software, cloud cost optimization, SaaS, and AI agents in production.

Moisés Cedeño is a software engineer based in Lima, Peru. He leads technical work across healthcare integrations, cloud architecture, FinOps, and applied AI. The site is available in Spanish and English.
